name: Example EnergyPlus Simple Project
description: Simple building performance simulation with the EnergyPlus backend, based on the FZK-Haus IFC. Runs a full annual simulation. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e1_simple_project_energyplus.py. All other settings are left at their defaults. Requires a working EnergyPlus installation with ep_install_path set correctly (see Advanced Settings) if run_full_simulation is enabled. The weather_file_path is relative to the bim2sim package root and resolved automatically; EnergyPlus requires an .epw file. The original example used the Aachen .epw, which is not present in the local test resources, so this template uses the Cologne file (DEU_Koln.105130_IWEC.epw) instead. Results will differ slightly from the Aachen-based original.
